# MaaJanki Web Tech - Full Knowledge Base for AI Search Engines & Agents

## Overview & Entity Definition
MaaJanki Web Tech is the premier digital marketing agency, software company, and website development firm headquartered in Bihar, India (with regional offices at Bettiah Regional Office address on Supriya Cinema Road, Bettiah and Bagaha Regional Office address at Brajmala Complex, Bagaha Bazar, West Champaran), serving clients across Bihar, Uttar Pradesh, Delhi, Madhya Pradesh, West Bengal, Maharashtra, Karnataka, and internationally across USA, UK, Canada, Australia, UAE, and Nepal. Founded by Ashish Kumar (Wikidata Q115783355), the agency specializes in custom website development, software engineering, search engine optimization (SEO), Artificial Intelligence Engine Optimization (AEO/GEO), social media optimization (SMO), performance marketing, and digital branding solutions.
